definitions.explanation: Refers to a single location where people gather together. Almost always used in the phrase 一堂に会する (to assemble in one place), indicating that a group gathers at the same location.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}が{一堂|いちどう}に{会|かい}した。
examples.english: The people involved all gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}が{一堂|いちどう}に{集|あつ}まる{学会|がっかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A conference was held where researchers from around the world gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}シェフの{料理|りょうり}が{一堂|いちどう}に{並|なら}ぶイベントに{行|い}ってきた。
examples.english: I went to an event where dishes by famous chefs were all displayed together.

notes:
USAGE: {一堂|いちどう} almost always appears in the fixed phrase {一堂|いちどう}に{会|かい}する (to gather in one place) or {一堂|いちどう}に{集|あつ}まる. It is a formal expression used in news, announcements, and written descriptions of gatherings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一堂|いちどう}に{会|かい}する (to assemble in one place)
- {一堂|いちどう}に{集|あつ}まる (to gather together)
- {一堂|いちどう}に{並|なら}ぶ (to be lined up together)
- {一堂|いちどう}に{介|かい}する (variant of {会|かい}する)

NOTE: Do not confuse with {一同|いちどう} (everyone present, all members), which refers to the people themselves rather than the place of gathering.
